subtitle: Configure data collection and alert notifications

appearance.title: General
appearance.language_hint: Changes apply immediately and your choice is remembered

save.reset_confirm: Reset all settings to their default values?
save.reset_success: Settings reset. Restart the app for the changes to take effect.

collector.title: Data Collection
collector.description: Configure the Starlink device connection and collection parameters
collector.router_address_hint: Router address (used for ICMP ping probing)
collector.buffer_size_hint: Number of historical data points to keep

location.title: Terminal Location
location.description: Set the terminal's geographic position; used to compute satellite elevation and azimuth
location.save_tooltip: Save the terminal location to local storage
location.save_disabled_hint: Enter latitude/longitude or get the current location first
location.need_coords: Fill in the latitude and longitude above, or click "Get current location" to auto-fill, before saving.
location.saved_hint: After saving, the Satellite Radar page immediately recalculates satellite elevation for this position.
location.usage_1: Click "Get current location" to auto-fill the coordinates (requires browser location permission)
location.usage_2: Or type the latitude and longitude manually
location.usage_3: Then click "Save location" to store them locally
location.privacy: Data is stored only in the local browser and is never uploaded to a server
location.got_position: Current location acquired: {{lat}}, {{lon}}. Click "Save location" to save it.
location.permission_denied: Location permission was denied. Enter the coordinates manually, or allow location access in your browser settings and try again.
location.position_unavailable: Location unavailable. Please enter the coordinates manually.
location.timeout: Location request timed out. Try again or enter the coordinates manually.
location.not_supported: Your browser does not support geolocation. Please enter the coordinates manually.
location.lat_invalid: Latitude must be between -90 and 90 (current value: {{value}})
location.lon_invalid: Longitude must be between -180 and 180 (current value: {{value}})

thresholds.title: Alert Thresholds
thresholds.description: Configure the thresholds that trigger alerts
thresholds.high_latency_hint: Trigger an alert when PoP latency exceeds this value (default 100 ms)
thresholds.high_packet_loss_hint: Trigger an alert when packet loss exceeds this value (default 10%)

probes.title: Probe Node Management
probes.description: Configure network reachability probe targets; probes run actively at each layer to help locate faults
probes.trace_target_hint: Target traced by the Route Trace card on the dashboard. Leave empty to use example.com.
probes.empty: No probe nodes yet. Click "Add probe" to add one.
probes.footer: ICMP probing uses ping; DNS probing resolves the domain; TLS probing performs a handshake and verifies the certificate. Click "Save" at the top for changes to take effect.

notifications.telegram_description: Receive alert notifications through a Telegram bot
notifications.webhook_description: Send alerts to a custom HTTP endpoint
notifications.webhook_headers_hint: Optional. A JSON object (string keys and values) used to authenticate against the endpoint
notifications.webhook_headers_invalid: Request headers must be a valid JSON object
notifications.webhook_template_hint: JSON template. Use {{variable}} placeholders to insert alert fields
notifications.webhook_template_invalid: The template does not render to valid JSON
notifications.webhook_vars_help: Variables available in the template (listed below in monospace). Each placeholder is replaced with the matching alert content, e.g. {{alert_title}}.
notifications.public_channel_offline_hint: Note: On a single-link setup, severe outage alerts will be sent after connectivity is restored. For real-time outage notifications, use a multi-WAN router or enable a Cloud watchdog.

grafana.title: Grafana Integration
grafana.description: Automatically provision the Prometheus data source and dashboard
grafana.api_key: API Key (optional, takes precedence over username/password)
grafana.api_key_placeholder: Leave empty to use username/password authentication
grafana.provision_hint: Click "Provision automatically" to create the Prometheus data source and the Starlink monitoring dashboard in Grafana

cloud.title: Updates & anonymous feedback
cloud.description: Check for new versions and anonymously report false positives to improve alert detection
cloud.feedback_desc: When enabled, alerts you mark as false positives are uploaded anonymously with their snapshot, to tune detection thresholds. No accounts or notification credentials are included; coordinates and IP address are.
cloud.hint_dev_mode: Update checks are disabled in dev mode (they only run in packaged builds)
cloud.hint_updater_unavailable: The updater component is unavailable; check that the install is complete
